+def normalize_trailing_whitespace(workspace: Path, paths: list[str], logger: EventLogger | None = None) -> list[str]:
+    """Remove only horizontal whitespace at line ends in agent-mutated UTF-8 text files.
+
+    ``git diff --check`` rejects this mechanically, but asking the model to repair
+    invisible spaces wastes turns and exact ``replace_text`` cannot reliably target
+    whitespace that ``read_file`` does not make visible.  Keep this deliberately
+    narrow: no fuzzy replacements, no unrelated files, no binary data.
+    """
+    changed: list[str] = []
+    for rel in sorted({str(path).strip().replace("\\", "/") for path in paths if str(path).strip()}):
+        path = (workspace / rel).resolve()
+        try:
+            path.relative_to(workspace.resolve())
+        except ValueError:
+            continue
+        if not path.is_file() or path.is_symlink():
+            continue
+        raw = path.read_bytes()
+        if b"\x00" in raw:
+            continue
+        try:
+            text = raw.decode("utf-8")
+        except UnicodeDecodeError:
+            continue
+        normalized = re.sub(r"[ \t]+(?=\r?$)", "", text, flags=re.M)
+        if normalized == text:
+            continue
+        path.write_bytes(normalized.encode("utf-8"))
+        changed.append(rel)
+    if changed and logger is not None:
+        logger.emit(
+            "runtime",
+            "Trailing whitespace in Agent-Dateien automatisch bereinigt: " + ", ".join(changed),
+            paths=changed,
+        )
+    return changed
+

+def write_worktree_patch(workspace: Path, paths: list[str], target: Path) -> None:
+    """Persist the exact agent-mutated diff, including untracked files, without touching the real index."""
+    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    fd, index_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix="hermclaw-artifact-index-")
+    os.close(fd)
+    index_path = Path(index_name)
+    try:
+        index_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
+        env = {**os.environ, "GIT_INDEX_FILE": str(index_path)}
+        read_tree = subprocess.run(
+            ["git", "read-tree", "HEAD"], cwd=workspace, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=30, env=env
+        )
+        if read_tree.returncode != 0:
+            target.write_text("# Patch unavailable: " + redact(read_tree.stdout + read_tree.stderr), encoding="utf-8")
+            return
+        selected = sorted({str(path).strip().replace("\\", "/") for path in paths if str(path).strip()})
+        if selected:
+            add = subprocess.run(
+                ["git", "add", "-A", "--", *selected], cwd=workspace, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=60, env=env
+            )
+            if add.returncode != 0:
+                target.write_text("# Patch unavailable: " + redact(add.stdout + add.stderr), encoding="utf-8")
+                return
+        diff = subprocess.run(
+            ["git", "diff", "--cached", "--binary", "--no-ext-diff", "--"],
+            cwd=workspace, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=60, env=env,
+        )
+        target.write_text(diff.stdout if diff.returncode == 0 else "# Patch unavailable: " + redact(diff.stdout + diff.stderr), encoding="utf-8")
+    finally:
+        index_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
+
+
+def render_protocol(events_path: Path, protocol_path: Path) -> None:
+    """Render the redacted JSONL event stream into the human-readable protocol used in the UI/console."""
+    lines: list[str] = []
+    if events_path.exists():
+        for raw in events_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines():
+            try:
+                event = json.loads(raw)
+                kind = str(event.get("kind", "event")).upper()
+                message = redact(str(event.get("message", "")))
+                lines.append(f"[{kind}] {message}")
+            except Exception:
+                lines.append("[EVENT] " + redact(raw))
+    protocol_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    protocol_path.write_text("\n".join(lines) + ("\n" if lines else ""), encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def publish_run_artifacts(
+    repo: str,
+    base_branch: str,
+    job_id: str,
+    code_branch: str,
+    task: str,
+    job_dir: Path,
+    workspace: Path,
+    files_changed: list[str],
+    push: bool,
+    logger: EventLogger,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Publish diagnostics on a separate ``agent-runs/<job>`` branch.
+
+    The diagnostics branch is intentionally separate from the code branch so run
+    logs never pollute a later merge.  It is published on both success and
+    failure when ``--push`` is enabled.
+    """
+    protocol_path = job_dir / "protocol.log"
+    render_protocol(job_dir / "events.jsonl", protocol_path)
+    write_worktree_patch(workspace, files_changed, job_dir / "working-tree.patch")
+    metadata = {
+        "version": VERSION,
+        "job_id": job_id,
+        "code_branch": code_branch,
+        "base_branch": base_branch,
+        "published_at": utc_now(),
+        "task": redact(task),
+        "files_changed": sorted(files_changed),
+    }
+    (job_dir / "metadata.json").write_text(json.dumps(metadata, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    if not push:
+        return {"published": False, "branch": None, "reason": "--push nicht gesetzt"}
+
+    artifact_branch = f"agent-runs/{slugify(job_id, 80)}"
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="hermclaw-run-artifacts-") as td:
+        clone = Path(td) / "repo"
+        proc = subprocess.run(
+            ["git", "clone", "--no-tags", repo, str(clone)], text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=180
+        )
+        if proc.returncode != 0:
+            raise AgentError("Diagnose-Repository konnte nicht geklont werden:\n" + truncate(proc.stdout + proc.stderr, 3000))
+        run_git(["fetch", "origin", base_branch], cwd=clone)
+        run_git(["switch", "-c", artifact_branch, f"origin/{base_branch}"], cwd=clone)
+        run_git(["config", "user.name", os.environ.get("HERMCLAW_GIT_NAME", "Hermclaw Agent")], cwd=clone)
+        run_git(["config", "user.email", os.environ.get("HERMCLAW_GIT_EMAIL", "hermclaw-agent@local")], cwd=clone)
+        dest = clone / ".hermclaw" / "runs" / slugify(job_id, 80)
+        dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        for name in ("protocol.log", "events.jsonl", "sources.json", "result.json", "metadata.json", "working-tree.patch"):
+            src = job_dir / name
+            if src.exists():
+                (dest / name).write_bytes(src.read_bytes())
+        (dest / "README.txt").write_text(
+            "Hermclaw run diagnostics. Dieser Branch dient nur der Diagnose und soll nicht in den Code-Branch gemergt werden.\n"
+            "Der vollständige Modell-Transcript (transcript.jsonl) wird absichtlich nicht auf Git veröffentlicht.\n",
+            encoding="utf-8",
+        )
+        run_git(["add", "-A", "--", ".hermclaw/runs"], cwd=clone)
+        run_git(["commit", "-m", f"Hermclaw run protocol: {job_id}"], cwd=clone)
+        commit = run_git(["rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=clone).stdout.strip()
+        run_git(["push", "-u", "origin", artifact_branch], cwd=clone, timeout=180)
+    logger.emit("git", f"Run-Protokoll zu GitLab gepusht: {artifact_branch}", branch=artifact_branch, commit=commit)
+    return {"published": True, "branch": artifact_branch, "commit": commit}
+

+@if "%DEBUG%"=="" @echo off
+@rem ##########################################################################
+@rem
+@rem  Gradle startup script for Windows
+@rem
+@rem ##########################################################################
+
+@rem Set local scope for the variables with windows NT shell
+if "%OS%"=="Windows_NT" setlocal
+
+set DIRNAME=%~dp0
+if "%DIRNAME%"=="" set DIRNAME=.
+@rem This is normally unused
+set APP_BASE_NAME=%~n0
+set APP_HOME=%DIRNAME%
+
+@rem Resolve any "." and ".." in APP_HOME to make it shorter.
+for %%i in ("%APP_HOME%") do set APP_HOME=%%~fi
+
+@rem Add default JVM options here. You can also use JAVA_OPTS and GRADLE_OPTS to pass JVM options to this script.
+set DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS="-Xmx64m" "-Xms64m"
+
+@rem Find java.exe
+if defined JAVA_HOME goto findJavaFromJavaHome
+
+set JAVA_EXE=java.exe
+%JAVA_EXE% -version >NUL 2>&1
+if %ERRORLEVEL% equ 0 goto execute
+
+echo. 1>&2
+echo ERROR: JAVA_HOME is not set and no 'java' command could be found in your PATH. 1>&2
+echo. 1>&2
+echo Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the 1>&2
+echo location of your Java installation. 1>&2
+
+goto fail
+
+:findJavaFromJavaHome
+set JAVA_HOME=%JAVA_HOME:"=%
+set JAVA_EXE=%JAVA_HOME%/bin/java.exe
+
+if exist "%JAVA_EXE%" goto execute
+
+echo. 1>&2
+echo ERROR: JAVA_HOME is set to an invalid directory: %JAVA_HOME% 1>&2
+echo. 1>&2
+echo Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the 1>&2
+echo location of your Java installation. 1>&2
+
+goto fail
+
+:execute
+@rem Setup the command line
+
+set CLASSPATH=%APP_HOME%\gradle\wrapper\gradle-wrapper.jar
+
+
+@rem Execute Gradle
+"%JAVA_EXE%" %DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS% %JAVA_OPTS% %GRADLE_OPTS% "-Dorg.gradle.appname=%APP_BASE_NAME%" -classpath "%CLASSPATH%" org.gradle.wrapper.GradleWrapperMain %*
+
+:end
+@rem End local scope for the variables with windows NT shell
+if %ERRORLEVEL% equ 0 goto mainEnd
+
+:fail
+rem Set variable GRADLE_EXIT_CONSOLE if you need the _script_ return code instead of
+rem the _cmd.exe /c_ return code!
+set EXIT_CODE=%ERRORLEVEL%
+if %EXIT_CODE% equ 0 set EXIT_CODE=1
+if not ""=="%GRADLE_EXIT_CONSOLE%" exit %EXIT_CODE%
+exit /b %EXIT_CODE%
+
+:mainEnd
+if "%OS%"=="Windows_NT" endlocal
+
+:omega
